termpaper themes

A look for every scene.

A theme is a colour grade, a palette and a few effects, saved in a small file that works on every scene. Try one below, make your own in the studio, and share it with a code.

Make a themeUse one

Use a theme

In termpaper press ?, then Tab to Themes, and pick one. Or from a shell:

$termpaper theme install tokyo-night
$termpaper --theme tokyo-night

A share code (it starts with tp1:) works anywhere a theme name does: paste it on the Themes page (i) or run termpaper theme import tp1:….
